# Solvang Guide (solvangguide.com)
> Solvang CA guide for Danish Days 2026, Santa Ynez Valley wine tours, and Solvang events 2026–2027.

## Key Sections & Events
- Home: Overall travel guide, bakeries, hotels, and local highlights. https://solvangguide.com/
- Wine & Experiences: Santa Ynez Valley wine tours, Foxen Canyon wine trail, e-bike vineyard rides, luxury stays. https://solvangguide.com/wine-and-experiences.html
- Danish Days 2026: Official festival guide, Danish heritage, æbleskiver breakfast, parades. Friday, September 18 – Sunday, September 20, 2026. https://solvangguide.com/#danish-days-2026
- Christmas 2026 (Julefest): Holiday lights, candlelight tours, Christmas market guide. November 27, 2026 – January 3, 2027 (Tree Burn January 8, 2027). https://solvangguide.com/christmas.html
- Taste of Solvang 2027: Annual food and wine festival, chef tastings, vineyard pairings. Friday, March 19 – Sunday, March 21, 2027. https://solvangguide.com/taste-of-solvang-2027.html
- Spring Wine Fest 2027: Solvang Spring Wine & Food Festival in Solvang Park on Mission Drive. Saturday, May 8, 2027, 11:00 AM–5:00 PM. Valley pours, cheese pairings, live music. https://solvangguide.com/solvang-spring-wine-festival-2027.html
- Wine Marathon 2027: Santa Ynez Valley wine country running event, half-marathon, wine tasting passes. Saturday, May 8, 2027. https://solvangguide.com/solvang-wine-marathon-2027.html

## Place
Solvang, CA 93463 — Danish Capital of America in Santa Barbara County. About 45 minutes from Santa Barbara and 2–2.5 hours from Los Angeles via US-101. Downtown is walkable along Mission Drive and Copenhagen Drive.

## Practical facts
- Parking: Use free lots on the Alisal Road edge and behind Mission Drive; walk downtown on festival days.
- Hotels: Compare boutique Solvang and Santa Ynez Valley stays on the interactive hotel map (Stay22 aid=6a77a27277376ac909f8c1d3).
- Tours: Book wine tastings, village rides, and coastal excursions via GetYourGuide (partner_id=Y2EKWLC).
